material_result: In the reduced source-derived system, per-step temporal supervision strongly improved recurrent robustness and long-horizon perturbation contraction relative to same-architecture final-only recurrence. A parameter-matched non-recurrent primitive encoder remained competitive or better on input corruption. Forcing hidden PR near 2D did not improve contraction and reduced interpolation robustness in the matched-clean seed, so low-dimensional circular geometry alone was not sufficient under the tested reduced conditions.
